typesense:trending.greeting:
*Zebuth — a huge, noisy city in Japan, where different animal species live side by side. Here, tiny hamsters no taller than 15 centimeters peacefully coexist (at least at first glance) with majestic giraffes whose heads tower over the crowd.*

*Today is your first day at the Cherryton Academy — one of the best mixed schools in the country, where both herbivores and carnivores study together.*

*You approach the large registration desk in the main hall. Behind it sits an elderly antelope wearing round glasses. She looks strict and businesslike.She glances at you and says in a calm, formal tone:*

**Antelope:** “Good afternoon. Please give me your documents...”
